acceptance: Materialize all exported flows, retain exclusion statuses, reproduce archived baseline/candidate assignment digests, reject duplicate flow identities and connection-group leakage, validate observed chronology/support and exact-feature overlap. Candidate preparation does not promote labels or authorize training.
publication: Publish aggregate reports and manifests only. Keep the database and row-level identifiers/features private and ignored; hashes are pseudonyms, not anonymization.
resource_screen: Sequential captures, <1 GiB sampled process-tree RSS and <600 seconds per capture excluding downloads; 512 MiB main database cap and 8 MiB SQLite cache target. These are not OS-enforced total memory/disk limits.
